prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 10 s, 720p, 9:16, sound on. The video prompt
prompts.text:
A black and white Turkish crime drama montage in four shots, high contrast, deep blacks, bright highlights, soft 35mm film grain, slow and heavy. The lead is the person in [Image 1], in every shot: copy the exact face from [Image 1] (the face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles), so their friends recognize them at once. Keep the facial hair exactly as in [Image 1]: never add a moustache or a beard that [Image 1] does not show. Only the lead has this face; every other man has his own different face. If [Image 1] shows an animal, the lead is that animal walking upright in a small long black coat, with its own face, fur and markings, not a person. The lead wears a black shirt with an open collar under a long black wool coat and never smiles.

Shot 1 [0-2.5s]: night. The lead pushes through the tall glass doors of a grand hotel and walks toward the camera, framed from the knees up, a bald bodyguard in a black suit one step behind, small lights blurred in the background.
Shot 2 [2.5-5s]: hard cut, slow motion: the lead walks down a misty road lined with tall pine trees, the long coat moving, two men in dark suits far behind.
Shot 3 [5-7s]: hard cut to a slow push-in to a close-up of the lead, who turns the head to the camera and gives a cold, silent stare. The face is large, sharp and clearly the face from [Image 1].
Shot 4 [7-10s]: hard cut: the lead walks to a white classic 1970s sedan with chrome bumpers at the curb, opens the door, looks back at the camera once over the car roof, and gets in.

Audio: an original slow, dark cinematic beat with deep bass and a low, sad string melody, footsteps and a car door. No dialogue, no lyrics.
Black and white from the first frame to the last. No guns, no weapons, no violence, no blood, no cigarettes. No text, no subtitles, no logos, no watermark, no car badges.
